rag.text:
Test: TC-2501 — Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Editing tasks in jira issue view
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-66 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing
Labels: teamspace

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName and click Scale to fit button
   Data: boxName: TC-2501 Feature area - Task - Attributes displaying and editing - Editing tasks in jira issue view
   Expected: Gantt chart is displayed. FolLowing tasks are displayed in WBS and Gantt chart:
- TC-2501 Editing tasks in jira issue view
- TC-2501 Parent task 1
- TC-2501 Child task 1A
- TC-2501 Parent task 2
- TC-2501 Child task 2A
2. Click on issue key of taskName to open Jira issue view
   Data: taskName: TC-2501 Parent task 1
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened in new tab
3. Change summary to newSummary, status to newStatus, start date to newStartDate.
   Data: newSummary: TC-2501 Parent task edited
newStatus: In Progress
newStartDate: 01/Oct/21
   Expected: Changes are saved
4. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName and click Scale to fit button
   Data: boxName: TC-2501 Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations - Editing tasks in jira issue view
   Expected: Gantt chart is displayed. FolLowing tasks are displayed in WBS and Gantt chart:
- TC-2501 Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations - Editing tasks in jira issue view
- TC-2501 Parent task edited
- TC-2501 Child task 1A
- TC-2501 Parent task 2
- TC-2501 Child task 2A
5. Click on issue key of taskName to open Jira issue view
   Data: taskName: TC-2501 Child task 1A
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened in new tab
6. Change the end date to newEndDate and start date to newStartDate
   Data: newStartDate: 16/Sep/21
newEndDate: 30/Sep/21
   Expected: Task dates are correctly changed
7. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName and click Scale to fit button
   Data: boxName: TC-2501 Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations - Editing tasks in jira issue view
   Expected: Gantt chart is displayed. TC-2501 Child task 1A has start date set to 16/Sep/21 and end date set to 30/Sep/21
8. Open Data dropdown and choose Re-sync option
   Expected: All changes made to tasks are preserved
9. Click on issue key of taskName to open Jira issue view
   Data: taskName: TC-2501 Child task 2A
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened in new tab
10. Change assignee to newUser
   Data: newUser: testlab.14
   Expected: Assignee is correcly changed.
11. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2501 Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations - Editing tasks in jira issue view
   Expected: On WBS assignee for TC-2501 Child task 2A is changed to testlab.2
